Q: Error Code 1054 unknown column in 'field list' error without Group Concat Actor A:

GROUP_CONCAT() works because it combines multiple actor rows into a single value for each film. If you want one actor per row instead, select CONCAT(actor.first_name, ' ', actor.last_name) and remove or adjust the GROUP BY to include actor.actor_id.

Q: Invalid date syntax in PostgreSQL A:

Single quotes create text values, so 'b.Date' means the text b.Date, not the column.

Use column names without quotes, or double quotes if they are case-sensitive e.g. b.Date or "b"."Date" (note the column name and the table name/table alias need to be quoted separately not together).

Q: What is the correct Content Type of an .xps file A:

According to this resource it will be application/vnd.ms-xpsdocument or application/oxps depending on the file
